svg.title: Data collection, rubric annotation, and judging workflow
svg.desc: Three-column diagram. Left frame contains data collection with user query, query-based filter, web implementation code/web comparisons and compatibility-validity wedge. Middle frame contains rubric annotation with query-grounded arrow, a verifiable rubric tree, annotate arrow, preference label, and WebDevJudge summary. Right frame contains judging: evaluator and observation sections, agentic/interaction subsections, and paradigm pairwise/single comparison cards. No SAM assets are present; all content is constructed as editable native SVG.

g.desc: Origin is the user query at top. Content proceeds downward through a query-based filter into web implementation; left side contains Code A and Code B browser-code icons, right side contains rendered Web A and Web B pages, with a vertical compatibility-validity filter wedge between code and web outputs.

text.tspan: Build a book review form with rating, author, and
text fields; display each review with user avatar

text.font-family: Comic Sans MS, Comic Neue, cursive
Comic Sans MS, Comic Neue, cursive

g.desc: Origin is the query-grounded arrow on the left leading to the rubric tree. The rubric tree is horizontally organized from ROOT to Intention, Static, and Dynamic branches, with leaf cards below. The lower direction contains an annotation arrow to a preference-label box, then a WebDevJudge block.

Origin is the Evaluator/Observation band under the Judge title. It contains an upper dashed evaluation-observation comparison region and a lower dashed agentic-interaction region. Bottom direction contains paradigm cards for pairwise and single judging.
